table_semantics.description: Line items belonging to orders, each row representing a product purchased within an order with quantity, pricing, discounts, and total line amount.
table_semantics.row_grain: one row per product line within an order

order_item_id.description: Unique identifier for the order line item.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order to which this line item belongs.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product being purchased.

quantity.description: Number of units of the product ordered.

unit_price.description: Price per single unit of the product at the time of the order.

item_discount.description: Discount amount applied to this line item.

line_amount.description: Total monetary amount for the line item after discount (quantity * unit_price - discount).
